description: Source code for the mod_cgi module of lighttpd, handling CGI script execution, environment setup, process management, and request handling.

classes.name: handler_ctx
classes.description: Context structure for handling CGI request/response cycle, including file descriptors, timing, and associated request and connection.

classes.name: cgi_pid_t
classes.description: Structure representing a CGI process, including process ID, signal state, and associated handler context.

methods.name: cgi_handler_ctx_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new handler context for CGI request handling.

methods.name: cgi_handler_ctx_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a handler context.

methods.name: mod_cgi_init
methods.description: Initializes plugin data, including environment variables, for CGI module.

methods.name: mod_cgi_free
methods.description: Cleans up allocated resources for the CGI plugin.

methods.name: mod_cgi_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges individual plugin configuration values into the plugin config structure.

methods.name: mod_cgi_merge_config
methods.description: Merges a list of plugin configuration values into the plugin config structure.

methods.name: mod_cgi_patch_config
methods.description: Creates a per-request plugin configuration based on global defaults and request conditions.

methods.name: mod_cgi_str_to_signal
methods.description: Converts a string to a corresponding signal number, with a default fallback.

methods.name: mod_cgi_parse_limits
methods.description: Parses CGI limits configuration array into cgi_limits structure.

methods.name: mod_cgi_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration for the CGI plugin, including environment and limits.

methods.name: cgi_pid_add
methods.description: Adds a new CGI process record to the global list.

methods.name: cgi_pid_kill
methods.description: Sends a signal to a CGI process.

methods.name: cgi_pid_del
methods.description: Removes a CGI process record from the global list.

methods.name: cgi_connection_close_fdtocgi
methods.description: Closes the file descriptor to CGI process stdout.

methods.name: cgi_connection_close
methods.description: Closes all CGI-related connections and cleans up handler context.

methods.name: cgi_connection_close_callback
methods.description: Callback to close CGI connection during request cleanup.

methods.name: cgi_write_request
methods.description: Writes request body data to CGI process stdin.

methods.name: cgi_handle_fdevent_send
methods.description: Handles write events for sending request data to CGI.

methods.name: cgi_process_wr_revents
methods.description: Processes write revents for CGI communication.

methods.name: cgi_response_headers
methods.description: Handles response headers from CGI and manages connection upgrade.

methods.name: cgi_local_redir
methods.description: Handles local redirection for CGI requests.

methods.name: cgi_recv_response
methods.description: Reads response data from CGI process.

methods.name: cgi_handle_fdevent
methods.description: Handles file descriptor events for CGI process stdout and stderr.

methods.name: cgi_process_rd_revents
methods.description: Processes read revents for CGI communication.

methods.name: cgi_env_offset_resize
methods.description: Resizes environment variable offsets buffer.

methods.name: cgi_env_add
methods.description: Adds an environment variable to the CGI environment buffer.

methods.name: cgi_create_env
methods.description: Creates environment variables and executes CGI process.

methods.name: mod_cgi_handle_subrequest
methods.description: Main subrequest handler for CGI, managing request/response cycle.

methods.name: mod_cgi_is_handled
methods.description: Determines if a request should be handled by CGI based on script path and permissions.

methods.name: mod_cgi_trigger_cb
methods.description: Periodic callback to handle CGI process timeouts.

methods.name: mod_cgi_waitpid_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when a CGI process terminates.
